summary: Produce a reviewable evidence and design argument for a fictional neurotechnology without presenting it as a validated device.
outcomes: Connect intended users and outcomes to design requirements and evidence gaps.
Integrate risk, access, consent and long-term support into one coherent plan.
sequence: Define a fictional use context with explicit assumptions
Create accessible interaction and recovery prototypes
Present a go/no-go rationale with unresolved questions

visual.question: Which promised benefit lacks the evidence or support needed to make it credible?
visual.interaction: Select a proposed feature to reveal user need, risk, test and evidence gap.

practice.task: Deliver an educational dossier with references, prototype and decision record.
practice.success: Claims match evidence; stakeholder assumptions are labeled; no compliance or treatment claim is fabricated.
